document_title: Stage 4.2.8 — AUTO-START-01: Autonomous Task Ingestion & Execution Acceptance Report

AS-01.description: Valid TXT enqueued, dispatched, and executed without new USER_INPUT or asking 'Начинаем?'

AS-02.description: Repeated poll cycles with existing acknowledged/succeeded task produce 0 agent calls

AS-03.description: Updating same file creates version 2 and enqueues update without lost ACK

AS-04.description: Concurrent dispatchers enforce single execution lock. Maximum 1 worker in RUNNING

AS-05.description: Missing runner executable or auth failure yields BLOCKED/FAILED, never SUCCEEDED

AS-06.description: Crash between dispatch and receipt with stale lease sets DISPATCH_UNKNOWN with 0 blind retries

AS-07.description: Empty file, non-UTF8, symlinks, traversal, shell metacharacters rejected safely

AS-08.description: Tampered spool file before dispatch fails hash check -> transitions to BLOCKED, 0 executions

AS-09.description: Task commanding production-write, reindex, force-push vetoed by policy before dispatch

AS-10.description: State migration creates backup and marks old ACK records HISTORICALLY_COMPLETED

AS-11.description: Queue preserved across inbox unavailability and pause flag. Resumes cleanly

AS-12.description: End-to-end task ingestion and execution verified in isolated environment with idempotency
